about_the_game:
Sneak-A-Snap is a stealthy, anime-inspired sandbox adventure where your camera is your weapon, timing is your skill, and your goal? Capture the perfect shot… without getting caught.

You play as a photography amateur with artistic ambitions and a not-so-innocent eye for detail. With your camera in hand and a city full of beautiful girls, you set out to build your portfolio—one steamy snapshot at a time. Whether it’s candid moments in public spaces or carefully orchestrated setups, every shot is a new challenge... and a new reward.

Blend into your environment, manipulate objects, and engineer perfect photo ops—all while staying hidden (or playing dumb when you're not). As your photo collection gains popularity, requests from your online followers get... more specific. It’s up to you how far you’re willing to go for the perfect snap.

content_descriptors.notes:
Sexual Themes & Nudity: Sneak-A-Snap features adult situations involving stealth photography of characters. Some outfits and angles reveal nudity.

Suggestive & Voyeuristic Elements: Gameplay centers on finding risqué photo opportunities. There is slight depiction of sexual acts.

No Minors, No Sexual Violence: All characters are consenting adults, and the game does not depict or condone sexual assault or non-consensual acts. We also do not use school settings or scenarios that would typically involve minors.

short_description: Like Hitman, but with a camera and... far less clothing. Sneak-A-Snap is a stealthy, anime-style sandbox game where you sneak around, set up diversions, and snap sexy photos of unsuspecting girls. Use gadgets, stealth, and playful creativity to build your fans one kinky shot at a time.
